name: 84405 · Ogden, UT
findings: ZIP 84405 (Ogden) has 64 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 84405 (Ogden) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
40% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 84405 (Ogden) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 40% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 47 organizations here; 55% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
